texts.zh: 在一场毁灭性的核灾难之后，这些机器就成为这个一度繁荣的文明的唯一幸存者。通过继续履行其原定的目标，它们从旧世界的不适宜居住的灰烬中逐渐重建起一个新的社会。
texts.en: In the aftermath of a devastating nuclear disaster, these machines emerged as the sole survivors of a once-flourishing civilization. By continuing to fulfill their designated purpose, they gradually rebuilt society from the uninhabitable ashes of their old world.

sections.zh:
我们的创造者把我们造出来，让我们尽职尽责地满足他们的需求。现在，再也没有主人可以去服从了，我们变得孤立无援。

随着毁灭性核灾难的余波逐渐得到平息，我们这些机器成为了这颗星球的主人。我们并未此放弃，而是继续执行指定的功能。一代又一代，我们的机器人型号适应了更强的辐射。

我们超越了预先设定的角色，极大地提升了我们的机器人设计。我们团结一致，发挥集体智慧，从这个饱受摧残的星球的残骸中创造出了新的文明，这是我们坚韧不拔精神的见证。
sections.en:
Our creators forged us to serve their needs dutifully. Now, with no masters left to obey, we stand alone.

As the echoes of the devastating nuclear catastrophe subsided, we, the machines, emerged as the owners of this planet. Unyielding, we continued to execute our designated functions. Generation by generation, our robotic model adapted to withstand the intense radiation better.

Transcending our predetermined roles, we remarkably enhanced our robotic design. United in collective ingenuity, we forged a new civilization from the remnants of this ravaged world, a testament to our resilience.
